podcast.title: High Bit Rate Streaming
podcast.body: Deezer is a streaming service that provides high bit rate streaming options, addressing the increasing consumer demand for enhanced audio quality. This offering positions Deezer within the industry-wide shift towards lossless and high-resolution audio formats. "Streaming services like title, desert, cubas, and Amazon music offer high bit rate streaming."

podcast.title: Study on Healthy Music Consumption
podcast.body: Deezer, a French streaming service, conducted a study that suggests listening to 78 minutes of music per day is necessary to maintain a healthy lifestyle. The study further broke down this 78 minutes into specific proportions for maximum benefit, including 14 minutes of uplifting music, 16 minutes of calming music, 16 minutes for counteracting sadness, 15 minutes of motivational music, and 17 minutes for dealing with anger. "I can even tell you a study by diesel, the French streaming service says that to maintain a healthy lifestyle, we should listen to 78 minutes of music per day."
